_comment: Known third-party skills for `aix skills add NAME`. Only entries with published evidence or wide, sustained adoption. Keep `evidence` honest: who measured, what, and the caveats. `group`: general = behaviour that applies to every session (style, method); specific = does one job when invoked. `recommended: true` lists the skill first with state `recommended` (be sparing). `class` (e.g. "coach/grill-me"): the skill is an implementation of that kit class; `add` selects it and the runtimes see it under the class name. Without `class` the skill keeps its bare name (something the kit has no class for).

caveman.description: Terse output: drops articles, filler, pleasantries and hedging while keeping all technical substance. Cuts output tokens.
caveman.evidence: Author benchmarks: 22-87% fewer output tokens over ten prompts. Caveat: only output shrinks; the rules cost ~1-1.5k input tokens per turn, so whole-session savings are lower. ~94k GitHub stars (mid-2026).

ponytail.description: 'Laziest senior dev' ladder before any code: does it need to exist, is it already in the codebase, reuse over rewrite, smallest change.
ponytail.evidence: Author agentic benchmark (12 feature tickets, FastAPI+React repo, n=4, Haiku 4.5): ~54% less code (up to 94%), ~20% cheaper, ~27% faster. Methodology in benchmarks/results/2026-06-18-agentic.md. ~124k stars.

karpathy-guidelines.description: Four principles against common LLM coding failures: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution.
karpathy-guidelines.evidence: No controlled benchmark. Derived from Karpathy's Jan 2026 observations; ~109k stars by May 2026. Overlaps with ponytail; pick one.

systematic-debugging.description: Four-phase root-cause process for bugs (reproduce, hypothesise, test, fix) instead of guess-and-patch.
systematic-debugging.evidence: No controlled benchmark. Part of obra/superpowers (~190k stars, MIT), the most adopted skills framework; widely reported to reduce debugging loops. Standalone, no other superpowers skill required.

verification-before-completion.description: Forbids claiming done without running the verification; evidence before completion claims.
verification-before-completion.evidence: No controlled benchmark. Part of obra/superpowers (~190k stars). Complements AIX definition-of-done; cheap (short SKILL.md).
